summary: This sermon explores love as the first and foundational fruit of the Spirit, distinguishing biblical agape love from ordinary affection. The preacher argues that God's love is self-giving and sacrificial, demonstrated ultimately in Christ's death, and that believers bear this fruit not by trying harder but by remaining in Christ and receiving his love.
key_points: Jesus summed up the Law and Prophets with love for God and neighbor
Agape love is not emotion but self-sacrificial action, redefined by Jesus through the cross
God is the source of love; we cannot produce it ourselves but must receive it from him
John wrote powerfully about love because he was convinced Jesus loved him personally
Bearing fruit happens by abiding in Christ, not striving in our own strength
big_idea: The love God calls us to is not something we muster through effort, but fruit that grows naturally as we remain connected to Christ and receive his unconditional, self-sacrificial love for us.
title: Abiding Love
